name: Tow Hooks / Straps
description: Front and rear tow points that recovery crews can reach without removing body parts, painted/marked in contrasting color.

components.name: Front tow strap / hook
components.description: Fabric tow strap or folding tow hook bolted to the front bumper beam/crash can, protruding through the fascia/splitter opening. Most sanctioning bodies require front and rear tow points clearly marked and accessible.
components.location: Front bumper beam right-of-center, x ≈ −0.88, y ≈ 0.38, z ≈ −0.30 (through lower fascia opening).

factory.name: GM screw-in tow eye (stored in trunk) threading into front bumper beam boss
factory.notes: Thread size not verified in sources – measure before buying an aftermarket screw-in hook.

raceOptions.name: Nylon racing tow strap (1.5–2 in webbing) with bolt eyelet
raceOptions.notes: Bolt through crash can/beam with backing plate.

hardware.spec: M10 x 1.5 or 3/8-16 bolt + large washer + nyloc through beam
hardware.notes: M10 torque per Schroth chart reference; confirm beam wall thickness/backing plate. Checked 2026-10: 50 N·m matches class 8.8 M10 (Atlas Copco 49 N·m). For 3/8-16 Grade 8, standard charts give 40-52 ft-lb. The tow-strap makers publish no torque. Upgraded to typical.

installNotes: Strap must clear splitter so towing does not tear off aero.
inspection: Check webbing and bolt each event.

sources.title: SCCA Time Trials – Full Safety Rules

components.name: Rear tow eye / strap
components.description: Rear tow point: factory screw-in rear tow eye in the rear bumper beam, or a fabric strap bolted to the rear beam/frame rail.
components.location: Rear bumper beam, x ≈ 3.80, y ≈ 0.40, z ≈ +0.30.

factory.name: GM rear bumper tow eye
factory.notes: Part number from a seller listing ("2016–2024 Camaro rear bumper tow eye hook OEM 22873449") – verify with GM parts.

raceOptions.name: Nylon racing tow strap bolted to rear beam

hardware.notes: Checked 2026-10: 50 N·m matches class 8.8 M10 (Atlas Copco 49 N·m). Upgraded to typical.

installNotes: Route clear of diffuser and exhaust heat.
